high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account @youfinance.in. The post provides information about Freshworks, a company with around 4,300 employees. According to the text, over 76% of these employees hold shares in the company. Following the listing and the Initial Public Offering (IPO), it is mentioned that this resulted in over 500 employees becoming crorepatis (millionaires) with approximately 70 of them being under the age of 30. The post includes a cartoon illustration of a person standing confidently with hands on hips, leaning against a large bag of money
